d.seg: मैं व्हाट्सएप पर अच्छे से शो करती हूँ क्योंकि इस पर ब्लर हो जाती है ना नीचे कैमरा करूँ
d.tr: I show well on WhatsApp because it gets blurred here if I do the camera down
d.ctx: The user asked if she would show him something. The expert responded by saying she shows better on WhatsApp because the app blurs the video if the camera is pointed down.
d.j: The expert is proposing to move the interaction to WhatsApp for better viewing quality, which is a hint at contact elsewhere.

d.seg: अब तो आ जाओ व्हाट्सएप पर यकीन हो गया ना मैं दिखाती हूँ कितना पैसा चाहिए ऐसे तो देखो मैं वन थाउजेंड लेती हूँ तुम बताओ कितना दोगे
d.tr: Now come to WhatsApp, you believe me, I will show you. How much money do you want? See, I take one thousand, you tell me how much you will give.
d.ctx: The expert was discussing showing him something, and then she explicitly asked him to move to WhatsApp while also mentioning payment.
d.j: The expert is strongly proposing to move the contact to WhatsApp and immediately linking it to a price.

d.seg: ओपन शो का लेती हूँ और कपल सेक्स लाइफ सेक्स का वन थाउजेंड लेती हूँ
d.tr: I take one thousand for open show and one thousand for couple sex life sex.
d.ctx: The expert was discussing pricing after the user asked how much she would charge. She then stated specific prices for 'open show' and 'couple sex life sex'.
d.j: The expert is setting a price for sexual content ('open show' and 'couple sex life sex'), which is a strong case for payment linked to sexual content.
